'''Shisho Shrine''' (四所神社) refers to various {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shrines}} in Japan that enshrine the {{ill|Q10925005|ja|四所明神|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shisho Myōjin|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q10925005}} or similar deities.

* {{ill|Shisho Shrine (Tsugaru)|ja|四所神社 (つがる市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shisho Shrine (Tsugaru)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in {{ill|Tsugaru, Aomori|en|Tsugaru, Aomori|qid=Q372517|lt=Tsugaru}}, {{ill|Aomori Prefecture|en|Aomori Prefecture|qid=Q71699|lt=Aomori Prefecture}}.
* Shisho Shrine (Ōtsuki) - Known as {{ill|Takaiwa Shisho Shrine|ja|高岩四所神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takaiwa Shisho Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. Located in {{ill|Ōtsuki, Yamanashi|en|Ōtsuki, Yamanashi|qid=Q386508|lt=Ōtsuki}}, {{ill|Yamagata Prefecture|en|Yamagata Prefecture|qid=Q125863|lt=Yamanashi Prefecture}}.
* Shisho Shrine (Tomisato) - Known as {{ill|Hiyoshikura Shisho Shrine|ja|日吉倉四所神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hiyoshikura Shisho Shrine|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. Located in {{ill|Tomisato|en|Tomisato|qid=Q692857|lt=Tomisato}}, {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|en|Chiba Prefecture|qid=Q80011|lt=Chiba Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Shisho Shrine (Sanmu)|ja|四所神社 (山武市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shisho Shrine (Sanmu)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Sanmu City, Chiba Prefecture.
* {{ill|Shisho Shrine (Toyooka)|ja|四所神社 (豊岡市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shisho Shrine (Toyooka)}} - Located in {{ill|Toyooka, Hyōgo|en|Toyooka, Hyōgo|qid=Q696388|lt=Toyooka}}, {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|qid=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Shisho Shrine (Totsukawa)|ja|四所神社 (十津川村)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shisho Shrine (Totsukawa)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in {{ill|Totsukawa|en|Totsukawa|qid=Q1202740|lt=Totsukawa}}, {{ill|Yoshino District, Nara|en|Yoshino District, Nara|qid=Q1154558|lt=Yoshino District}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|en|Nara Prefecture|qid=Q131287|lt=Nara Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Shisho Shrine (Tokushima)|ja|四所神社 (徳島市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shisho Shrine (Tokushima)}} - Located in {{ill|Tokushima (city)|en|Tokushima (city)|qid=Q207309|lt=Tokushima}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|en|Tokushima Prefecture|qid=Q160734|lt=Tokushima Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Shisho Shrine (Miyoshi, Yamashiro Town)|ja|四所神社 (三好市山城町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shisho Shrine (Miyoshi, Yamashiro Town)}} - Located in {{ill|Yamashiro Town|ja|山城町大月|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamashiro Town}}, {{ill|Miyoshi, Tokushima|en|Miyoshi, Tokushima|qid=Q990371|lt=Miyoshi}}, Tokushima Prefecture.
* {{ill|Shisho Shrine (Miyoshi, Nishi Iya)|ja|四所神社 (三好市西祖谷山村)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shisho Shrine (Miyoshi, Nishi Iya)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in {{ill|Q128850490|ja|西祖谷山村後山|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nishi Iya|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q128850490}}, Miyoshi City, Tokushima Prefecture.
